metadata.title: Household Finance Brokerage Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the consumer websites (peasy.be, hypotheekwinkel.be, verzekeringen.be / assurances.be and aanbieders.be / mesfournisseurs.be with simulators, comparison modules, booking, upload, budget barometer and content), to the household customer account (contract vault, savings alerts, signing and consent), to the advisor workbenches (the expert workbench in about 70 offices, the customer-care desk in Hasselt and Oujda and the knowledge base), to integrations (bank rate feeds and file submission, insurer quote and bind APIs, energy and telecom switch interfaces, e-signature, telephony and chat, e-mail and SMS), to the network and partner back office (franchise management, production dashboards, academy LMS, partner portal, commission reconciliation, compliance and audit) and to document outputs (feasibility certificate, proposal comparison, policy and switch documents, commission statements). Proprietary comparison technology with human experts on top; each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: The public web surfaces in Dutch and French where demand is generated: peasy.be as the single front door since early 2025, hypotheekwinkel.be for the mortgage brokerage and its office pages, verzekeringen.be / assurances.be for insurance and aanbieders.be / mesfournisseurs.be for energy, telecom and mobile. Simulators, comparison modules, appointment booking, upload-your-proposal, the budget barometer and content run here; comparing is free because the chosen partner pays a referral fee.

The Peasy front door: mortgage simulators, feasibility check, notary costs, upload-your-proposal, insurance, energy and telecom comparison, the budget barometer, appointment booking, callback and chat, blog and FAQ, in Dutch and French.

channels.description: The logged-in household account behind the consumer sites: the contract vault with every brokered contract and the documents of a running mortgage file, savings alerts by e-mail, SMS and in-app, and the signing and consent flows through which a household approves an advice record, a policy or a switch. This is where the household relationship lives after the first transaction.

One place per household for brokered policies, energy and telecom contracts and loan-linked insurance, the budget barometer profile, uploaded documents for a running credit file and the closing milestones of a mortgage.
